$comment: The Shape of Unn's slug form, for serene moments: very calm, rested, the desktop quiet (no input for a while, no Geo, no visitors). He melts into the slug (Slug Down), rests, crawls his ledge slowly (turning at its ends), rests again and stands back up (Slug Up). Anything that matters snaps him out through `slug_up` (transform back first). Started by name only (Ctx::wander_act).
